svg.text: WORKFLOW 1: Victim Crime Reporting → Officer Review → Investigation Initiation

g.text: Report a crime or provide information
Don't have an account? Sign up here
Are you an officer? Login as Officer
Report a crime or provide information
✅ Login successful! Redirecting to your dashboard...
• JWT Token issued — stored in localStorage
• Role: VICTIM | User: Sarah Khan | Redirecting to My Reports...
View and manage your submitted crime reports
👆 Click "+ Report a Crime" to open the report submission form (shown in next screen)
S4 — Report Crime Modal (Opened — Empty Form)
Your report will be reviewed by officers. Include as much detail as possible.
Violent, Property, Cyber, White_Collar, Drug_Related, Other
Drag & drop files here, or click to browse (Photos, Videos, Documents)
Max file size: 10MB — JPG, PNG, PDF, MP4, DOCX
All fields marked * are required. Submit button activates when required fields are filled.
S5 — Report Crime Modal (Filled + Submit Success)
Your report will be reviewed by officers. Include as much detail as possible.
On the night of Feb 15, I was walking home from work when an individual
approached me near the market and snatched my bag containing wallet and
phone. He was ~5'10", dark hoodie, fled on a black motorcycle towards Johar.
Plate number partially visible starting with "KHI-".
Not an officer? Login as Victim/Witness
• JWT token issued → Role: OFFICER | Access to: Crimes, Suspects, Evidence, Reports, Investigations, Analytics, Predictions
S7 — Officer: Crime Reports Review (Default State — No Popup)
Review and manage crime reports submitted by victims and citizens
👆 Click "📄 View" on Report #47 to open the detailed review popup (shown in next screen →)
S8 — Report Detail Modal + Accept / Reject Decision
Walking home, individual snatched bag with wallet & phone. Suspect ~5'10", dark hoodie, fled on black motorcycle towards Johar. Plate: "KHI-"
Similar nearby: 3 in 30 days | Duplicates: None | Severity: Major
Crime record (Open) + Investigation (Active) + Bridges + Email to victim
✅ Click "Accept" → opens Investigation Creation form (shown in next row ↓)
✅ Crime Report #47 Accepted — Crime Record Created (Crime ID: #102)
An official investigation is being created. Complete details below.
Report accepted based on cross-reference with 3 similar incidents in Gulshan area.
Priority actions: 1. Obtain CCTV 2. Canvas witnesses 3. Check "KHI-" plates 4. Cross-ref suspects
✅ Report_Crime bridge: #47 ↔ Crime #102 | Investigation_Crime: Inv ↔ Crime #102 | Crime_Victim: Crime ↔ Sarah
✅ Email notification sent to sarah.khan@email.com | Audit trail logged | Dashboard stats updated
Subject: Your Crime Report Has Been Accepted — Case CASE-2026-0015
Your crime report (#47) has been reviewed and accepted. Case: CASE-2026-0015 | Officer: Ahmed | Status: Active
Track your case in real-time by logging into your account.
After creation → Victim receives email and can track case in real-time (see next screen →)
S10 — Victim Portal: Case Tracking (Detail Popup Open)
Case: CASE-2026-0015 | Officer: Ahmed | Started: Feb 21, 2026 | Priority: High | Severity: Major
Feb 21, 2026 2:15 PM — Officer Ahmed reviewed. Case: CASE-2026-0015
Feb 21, 2026 4:00 PM — CCTV footage collected from Block 5 market area
Feb 22, 2026 — Potential suspect from CCTV. Verification ongoing.
Crime ID: #102 | Type: Violent — Snatch Theft
Location: Block 5, Main Blvd, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, Karachi
📧 Feb 21, 2:15 PM — Report accepted. Investigation initiated: CASE-2026-0015 | Officer: Ahmed
📧 Feb 21, 4:30 PM — Evidence collected: CCTV footage from Block 5 market. Review in progress.
📧 Feb 22, 11:00 AM — Officer Ahmed requests additional info about motorcycle. Reply through portal.

svg.text: Workflow 1 — Complete Flow Summary (Default → Action → Popup for Every Page)
S1: Victim Login (Empty) → S2: Login (Filled + Success) → S3: My Reports Dashboard (Default) → S4: "+ Report Crime" Modal (Empty Form) → S5: Modal (Filled + Success Toast)
S6: Officer Login (Filled) → S7: Crime Reports Review Table (Default) → S8: View Report Detail Popup + Accept/Reject Decision → S9: Investigation Creation Form → S10: Victim Case Tracking Popup
Project: Crime Management Analysis System (CMAS) | Entities: Crime, Investigation, Report_Crime, Investigation_Crime, Crime_Victim | Auth: JWT + bcrypt | Notifications: Email
Each screen shown in: Default/Empty State → Filled/Action Applied → Popup/Dialog (where applicable)
